title: Combined bench OFF arm must run in an empty temp dir or it reads repo source for gold answers
summary: Building the combined ON-vs-OFF cost-bounded bench (bench/zonoid_bench/combined_bench.py), found that --allowedTools "" alone does NOT disable claude -p built-in tools: a cold claude -p launched in the repo/worktree cwd lists and reads the actual source files (daemon.js etc.) that hold every gold answer. Observed empirically — OFF "solved" config probes (diminishing_rounds=3, overlap 0.6, cosine 0.55) at 75% accuracy by reading source, with 150-210k cache_read tokens from file exploration. FIX: run BOTH arms' answer completions in a fresh empty tempfile.mkdtemp() cwd (the scripts/bench-economy.js mkdtempSync discipline) PLUS --disallowedTools Read,Glob,Grep,Bash,... . After the fix OFF correctly fails (0%) on Zonoid-internal values it cannot know from world knowledge, and the OFF agent even reports "I don't have file-reading tools to search the codebase". This isolation is the honesty bar: ON knowledge then comes ONLY from injected retrieved context, OFF from world knowledge alone. Any future agentic bench arm that must NOT see a repo has to use empty-cwd isolation, not just an empty allowedTools list.
